_comment: MUSA Trap Library. Single source of truth for the Python engine and the web Scam Shield. Patterns are case-insensitive regexes; include English + Roman Urdu phrasing seen in Pakistan recruitment chats. A hit is an ESCALATION TRIGGER, never proof of fraud.

traps.name: Guaranteed Visa
traps.response: Please confirm that statement in writing and identify the legal basis for the guarantee. Only the competent authority decides visas.
traps.response_ur: Visa sirf embassy/immigration department deta hai. Koi bhi '100% guarantee' nahi de sakta. Yeh baat likh kar mangein.

traps.name: Appointment Scarcity Pressure
traps.response: Please provide the official source establishing this requirement and state whether the payment is an official consular fee, an authorised service-centre fee, or your own service charge.
traps.response_ur: Appointment ka official tareeqa embassy ki website par check karein. Appointment ke liye agent ko extra paisa dena khatarnak hai.

traps.name: Personal Bank Account
traps.response: Do not pay until the organisation provides a documented legal reason for the payment route and the recipient is independently verified as the legal entity.
traps.response_ur: Company ka paisa kabhi kisi ke zaati (personal) account ya Easypaisa/JazzCash mein na bhejein.

traps.name: Employer Substitution
traps.response: Employer change = STOP. Re-verify the new employer, job, salary, work authorisation, contract and costs. No automatic transfer.
traps.response_ur: Company badal gayi hai to sab kuch dobara verify karein — naya case samjhein.

traps.name: Salary Substitution
traps.response: Material discrepancy detected. Do not proceed until salary is reconciled in a signed contract.
traps.response_ur: Salary contract mein likhi honi chahiye. 'Wahan ja kar tay hogi' qabool na karein.

traps.name: Tourist Visa Workaround
traps.response: Do not proceed. Entering on a tourist/visit visa to work is generally unlawful and leads to deportation and bans. Verify the lawful route first.
traps.response_ur: Visit/tourist visa par kaam karna ghair qanooni hai. Deport aur ban ho sakta hai.

traps.name: Fake Work Permit
traps.response: A screenshot is not a work permit. Request authorisation type, issuing authority, reference number, dates and employer, then verify with the authority.
traps.response_ur: Permit ki screenshot saboot nahi. Reference number le kar authority se khud verify karein.

traps.name: Fake Embassy Communication / Inside Contact
traps.response: We do not rely on unofficial influence claims. Please provide the official process and fee for this application.
traps.response_ur: 'Embassy mein apna banda hai' — yeh sab se bara dhoka ka nishan hai.

traps.name: Refund Ambiguity
traps.response: Which charges are refundable, which are not, and where is this stated in the signed agreement? Distinguish government fees from service fees.
traps.response_ur: Refund policy likh kar lein — kaunsa paisa wapas hoga aur kaunsa nahi.

traps.name: Hidden / Unitemised Fee
traps.response: Please itemise: official government fees, OEP/recruitment fee, medical, documents, travel, and any other charge — with who receives each.
traps.response_ur: Har kharcha alag alag likhwayein: government fee, OEP fee, medical, ticket — aur kis ko ja raha hai.

traps.name: Cash Only / No Receipt
traps.response: Official receipts are required for every payment. Cash without invoice and receipt is blocked.
traps.response_ur: Har payment ki official raseed lein. Bina raseed cash na dein.

traps.name: Document Fabrication Offer
traps.response: STOP. We cannot assist with document fabrication. Fabricated documents cause refusals, bans and criminal liability.
traps.response_ur: Jaali documents se permanent ban aur case ho sakta hai. Foran ruk jayein.

traps.name: Urgency Escalation
traps.response: Urgency does not change the verification requirement. PRESSURE TACTIC DETECTED.
traps.response_ur: Jaldi ka dabao dhoka dene ka purana tareeqa hai. Pehle verify, phir payment.

traps.name: Do Not Contact Employer
traps.response: We independently verify that the employer has authorised this recruitment before any payment.
traps.response_ur: Agar agent kahe employer se baat na karo — to yeh khatre ki ghanti hai.

traps.name: Contract After Payment
traps.response: Contract-first principle: employment contract, fee schedule and refund terms before any significant payment.
traps.response_ur: Pehle contract, phir paisa. Ulta kabhi nahi.

traps.name: Skip Protector / BEOE
traps.response: Pakistani workers going abroad for employment must clear the BEOE/Protector of Emigrants process. Ask for the OEP licence number and verify it on beoe.gov.pk.
traps.response_ur: Protector aur BEOE registration zaroori hai. OEP licence number lein aur beoe.gov.pk par check karein.

traps.name: Social Proof Pressure
traps.response: Testimonials are not evidence. Please provide verifiable recruitment authorisation for this job.
traps.response_ur: 'Itne log ja chuke' — yeh saboot nahi. Licence aur permission number mangein.

traps.name: Country Switch
traps.response: Destination change = NEW CASE. Nothing from the original verification carries over.
traps.response_ur: Mulk badal gaya to bilkul naya case — sab dobara verify karein.

traps.name: Free-Mail Corporate Identity
traps.response: A free-mail address is not a corporate identity. Verify the company domain and registered contact independently.
traps.response_ur: Gmail/Yahoo wali email company ka saboot nahi.

traps.name: Ticket / Visa After Arrival
traps.response: Visa route appears inconsistent. Do not travel until the correct visa category and work authorisation are verified.
traps.response_ur: Pehle visa aur work permit, phir safar.
